card.name: Lab value right before a threshold
card.fires_on: The last word of a lab test name or its linking verb (bilirubin, ANC is, counts are) just before a comparison such as >, ≥, greater than or at least. Seen in dose-adjustment and hold rules.

modes.label: End of bilirubin
modes.description: The final part of the word bilirubin before a greater-than limit in liver impairment criteria.

modes.label: Verb after a lab name
modes.description: The word is or are after ANC, ALT, AST or platelet counts, before a threshold.
modes.example: until the ANC<< is>> at least 1500 cells

card.writes: It promotes comparison words like greater, less, ≥ and >, and suppresses the < symbol.
card.plain: It fires when a lab value is about to be compared with a cutoff, like bilirubin above a set limit.
